added: [[Category:Buying a Car]]
==Things You Should Know==
*'''Exterior:''' In daylight, look for small scratches in the paint, windows, and windshield, plus dents in the metal or gaps between panels and doors.
*'''Interior:''' Look for clean upholstery, mileage below 40 km (25 miles), and functional sound and heating/cooling systems.
*'''Performance:''' Do a test drive and note any strange sounds or vibrations. Ensure the ignition and gears work smoothly and test the horn and headlights.

added: It is important to properly inspect a new car before you drive it out of the showroom. If you are buying a brand new car, it shouldn't have any scratches, defects, or more than 50-100km on the odometer. However, knowing what else look for can be a little daunting for used cars. Whether your new car is brand new or previously used, this article will highlight the important things to check in your inspection.
=== Gather the appropriate documents.===

#Make sure the seller provides Insurance and Vehicle registration. Never finalize the sale without receiving this documentation.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 1.jpg|center]]
=== Keep a good rapport with the salespeople ===
#Be cheerful and act cordially with staff.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 2.jpg|center]]
#*Be Patient. Minor delays are sometimes unavoidable.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 3.jpg|center]]

#*If you find anything not up to your mark during inspection, simply note it down on a piece of paper and bring it to the notice of staff. Your aim should be to rectify any faults and not to create any unpleasant scene during what should essentially be a joyous occasion for you.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 4.jpg|center]]
#*Exchange business cards with salesperson, and service personnel.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 31.jpg|center]]
===Take your time to inspect.===
# Buying a car is an investment and giving it due time is expected.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 5.jpg|center]]
=== Get a complete demonstration from salesperson.===
# You should be aware of all functions before you take it to your inspection.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 6.jpg|center]]
===Note the mileage. ===

# Usually, anything below 40 km (25 miles) is acceptable. Though, this would vary depending on how your vehicle is delivered to the dealer from manufacturer's yard.<ref>https://www.consumerreports.org/cro/2012/12/picking-up-the-car/index.htm</ref>[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 7.jpg|center]]
===Inspect the bodywork.===

# Ensure you do it in daylight and in open space. Take your time and note down the smallest of imperfections. It is very difficult to justify scratches and minor dents to staff at later stage.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 8.jpg|center]]
=== Pay close attention to areas of connection.===
#Check all seams, panel gap consistencies, and door line. Be sure that they are aligned and match acceptable standards.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 9.jpg|center]]
===Check all doors, hood, & boot.===
#They should open and shut properly. In addition, all rubber linings should be soft (not cracked or brittle).[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 10.jpg|center]]
===Open the Bonnet.===
# Check fluid levels and engine compartment cleanliness.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 11.jpg|center]]

#*Also look for any cuts or splits in electrical wiring and connections. Also, check that the ECU of car is properly shielded.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 12.jpg|center]]
===Check the Battery.===

# Usually, most trusted brands of batteries have indicators showing the health of the battery. If not, ask service staff to confirm the health of battery and perform a battery test.<ref>https://carfromjapan.com/article/car-maintenance/how-to-test-a-car-battery/</ref>[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 13.jpg|center]]
===Confirm that all tires are new. ===
#Usually a new tire will have coloured stripes in centre. These wear off once the tire is used for some time.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 14.jpg|center]]
=== Inspect the windshield and windows.===
===Check the interior of the car.===

# Especially look out for any kind of soiling on the seats, upholstery and carpets. Make sure the cloth or leather of the interior is intact.<ref>https://www.consumerreports.org/cro/2012/12/picking-up-the-car/index.htm</ref>[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 16.jpg|center]]
===Turn on the ignition.===
# The car should start smoothly. [[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 17.jpg|center]]
#*Ensure that no warning lights are flashing on the instrument cluster.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 18.jpg|center]]
#*Ensure that fuel level is adequate and engine temperature is within acceptable range.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 19.jpg|center]]
===Crank the engine.===

# Lookout for any weird sound from engine compartment. It is advisable to crank the engine and then step out of the vehicle to inspect the sound of the vehicle. While you are at it, also check the emission levels from exhaust.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 20.jpg|center]]
===Turn on the air-conditioning / heating.===
#Let it run for a moment. Ensure it provides you with sufficient cooling / heating.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 21.jpg|center]]
=== Keep a list of all the extra bells and whistles that may have come with your car.===
#Try to operate and test all of them to ensure they work. [[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 22.jpg|center]]
===Switch on the headlights, fog lamps and parking lights.===

# Confirm that they operate properly. Ensure that headlights focus properly.<ref>https://www.consumerreports.org/headlights/how-consumer-reports-tests-car-headlights/</ref>[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 23.jpg|center]]
===Check the A/V system.===

#If the car is old, use your favourite CD or tape to test the sound system. Otherwise, be sure that the bluetooth or other sound connection features work. [[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 24.jpg|center]]
===Request a short test drive before delivery.===

#Buckle Up and ensure the seatbelts work. At this point, switch off the music system and put the air-conditioning on low speed so that you can listen to any abnormality.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 25.jpg|center]]
===Shift into gears.===
#Ensure that they slot properly. Also check if the vehicle has decent acceleration.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 26.jpg|center]]
=== Listen for abnormal sounds.===

#On your test drive, ensure that there are no rattles and NVH (Noise, Vibration and Harshness) levels are acceptable.<ref>https://shop.advanceautoparts.com/r/advice/car-maintenance/causes-of-car-noises-and-vibration</ref>[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 27.jpg|center]]
=== Test alignment.===
===Return to service centre.===

# Park the vehicle. Step out and open the hood. Check for any fluid leaks that may have popped up during trial.<ref>https://fixcarleaks.org/diagnose/</ref>[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 29.jpg|center]]
=== Request car records.===

#Meet the service manager and get all possible information regarding service schedules. You can also ask about good driving etiquette for your car.<ref>https://www.dmv.org/travel/driving-etiquette-safety-tips.php</ref>[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 30.jpg|center]]
===Bring to notice any faults that you may have encountered during the inspection.===
# Do this calmly and clearly. If you are not sure about something, mention it anyway. [[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 32.jpg|center]]
=== Double check the paperwork.===
=== Check tire pressure.===

#Before you drive away, make sure the tire pressure is at an appropriate level and consistent between all tires. <ref>https://www.cars.com/auto-repair/diy/check-tire-pressure/</ref>[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 34.jpg|center]]
=== Make sure your vehicle has any promised "extras" present.===
#This could include a spare tire, CD Changer, tool kits, chains, or warning triangles.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 37.jpg|center]]
=== Thank the service people. ===

#You are now ready to go! But, before you leave, thank and take a picture with your purchase and all those people who made your dream car a reality. [[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 35.jpg|center]]
===Drive off===
#Don't be afraid to show off your new car![[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 36.jpg|center]]
__LIST__

added: Buying a new car but don't know what to look for in your new ride ? Here are few tips which could save you from landing up with a defective vehicle.
#Ensure you are provided with all relevant documents like Insurance and Vehicle registration before taking final delivery.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 1.jpg|center]]
#Be Cheerful and act cordially with staff.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 2.jpg|center]]
#Be Patient. Minor delays are sometimes unavoidable.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 3.jpg|center]]

#If you find anything not up to your mark during inspection, simply note it down on a piece of paper and bring it to the notice of staff. Your aim should be to rectify any faults and not to create any unpleasant scene during what should essentially be a joyous occasion for you.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 4.jpg|center]]
#Take your time to inspect. Buying a car is an investment and giving it due time is expected.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 5.jpg|center]]

#Take a complete demonstration from salesperson. You should be aware of all functions before you take it to your inspection.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 6.jpg|center]]

#Note the mileage. Usually, anything below 40 km (25 miles) is acceptable. Though this would vary depending on how your vehicle is delivered to the dealer from manufacturer's yard.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 7.jpg|center]]

#Inspect the bodywork. Ensure you do it in daylight and in open space. Take your time and note down the smallest of imperfections. It is very difficult to justify scratches and minor dents to staff at later stage.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 8.jpg|center]]
#Check all seams, panel gap consistencies, and door line match to acceptable standards.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 9.jpg|center]]
#Check all doors, hood, & boot that they open and shut properly and that all rubber linings are soft.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 10.jpg|center]]
#Open Bonnet. Check fluid levels and engine compartment cleanliness.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 11.jpg|center]]

#Also look for any cuts or splits in electrical wiring and connections. Also, check that the ECU of car is properly shielded.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 12.jpg|center]]

#Check the Battery. Usually most trusted brands of batteries have indicators showing the health of the battery. If not, ask service staff to confirm the health of battery and perform a battery test.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 13.jpg|center]]

#Confirm that all tires are new. Usually a new tire would have coloured stripes in centre which wear off once tire is used for some time.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 14.jpg|center]]

#Check the windshields for any cracks, scratches or spots that may be difficult to remove later. Check wiper operations. Check and operate all windows. Ensure Power windows (if applicable) work properly.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 15.jpg|center]]

#Check the interior of the car. Especially look out for any kind of soiling of seats, upholstery and carpets. Make sure every kind of cloth or leather is intact.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 16.jpg|center]]
#Turn on the ignition.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 17.jpg|center]]
#Ensure that no warning lights are flashing on the instrument cluster.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 18.jpg|center]]
#Ensure that fuel level is adequate and engine temperature is within acceptable range.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 19.jpg|center]]

#Crank the engine. Lookout for any weird sound from engine compartment. It is advisable to crank the engine and then step out of the vehicle to inspect the sound of the vehicle. While you are at it, also check the emission levels from exhaust.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 20.jpg|center]]
#Turn on the air-conditioning / heating. Ensure it provides you with sufficient cooling / heating.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 21.jpg|center]]
#Try to operate and test all the bells and whistles that may have come with your car.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 22.jpg|center]]

#Switch on the headlights, fog lamps and parking lights. Confirm that they operate properly. Ensure that headlights focus properly.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 23.jpg|center]]
#Check the A/V system. Carry your favourite CD to test the sound system.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 24.jpg|center]]

#Buckle Up and request a short test drive before delivery. At this point, switch off the music system and put the air-conditioning on low speed so that you can listen to any abnormality.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 25.jpg|center]]
#Shift into gears. Ensure that they slot properly and vehicle has decent acceleration.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 26.jpg|center]]

#On your test drive, look for any abnormal sounds from engine or suspension system. Also, ensure that there are no rattles and NVH (Noise, Vibration and Harshness) levels are acceptable.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 27.jpg|center]]

#On a straight stretch, drive at a speed of 60 km/h and check that vehicle is properly aligned to road and there is no unusual vibration.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 28.jpg|center]]

#Return to service centre. Park the vehicle. Step out and open the hood. Check for any fluid leaks that may have popped up during trial.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 29.jpg|center]]
#Meet the service manager and get all possible information regarding service schedules and good driving etiquette.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 30.jpg|center]]
#Exchange business cards with salesperson, and service personnel.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 31.jpg|center]]
#Bring to notice any faults that you may have encountered during the inspection.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 32.jpg|center]]
#Note down Chassis No. and Engine No. of vehicle and confirm that it matches with the paperwork[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 33.jpg|center]]
#Check Air Pressure on the vehicle.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 34.jpg|center]]

#You are now ready to go! But, before you leave, do take a picture with your purchase and all those people who made your dream car a reality :)[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 35.jpg|center]]
#Drive off and Show off ![[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 36.jpg|center]]
#Check all additional items to be present in the vehicle like spare tire, CD Changer, tool kits and warning triangles.[[Image:Inspect a Newly Purchased Vehicle Before Delivery Step 37.jpg|center]]

added: [[Image:New 2006 Infiniti G35.jpg|right|246px|thumb|Is your car really new ?]]Buying a new car but don't know what to look for in your new ride ? Here are few tips which could save you from landing up with a defective vehicle.
== Steps ==
#  Ensure you are provided with all relevant documents like Insurance and Vehicle registration before taking final delivery.
#  [[Image:Day 63   365   There is no Happy here....jpg|right|184px]]Be Cheerful and act cordially with staff
#  Be Patient. Minor delays are sometimes unavoidable.

#  [[Image:Notepad_on_the_clear_page.JPG|right|183px|thumb|Carry a notepad]]If you find anything not up to your mark during inspection, simply note it down on a piece of paper and bring to the notice of staff. Your aim should be to rectify any faults and not to create any unpleasant scene during what should essentially be a joyous occasion for you.
#   Take your time to inspect. Buying a car is an investment and giving it due time is expected.
#  Take a complete demonstration from salesperson. You should be aware of all functions before you take to your inspection.

#  [[Image:Mileage = 123456.jpg|right|184px]]Note the mileage. Usually, anything below 40 kms (25 miles) is acceptable. Though this would vary depending on how your vehicle is delivered to the dealer from manufacturer's yard.

#  Inspect the bodywork. Ensure you do it daylight and in open space. Take your time and note down smallest of imperfections. It is very difficult to justify scratches and minor dents to staff at later stage.
#  Check all seams, panel gap consistencies, and door line match to acceptable standards.
#  Check all doors, hood, & boot open and shut properly and all rubber linings are soft.
#  Open Bonnet. Check fluid levels and engine compartment cleanliness.
#  Also look for any cuts or splits in electrical wirings and connections. Also, check the ECU of car is properly shielded.

#  [[Image:My dead battery.jpg|right|184px]]Check the Battery. Usually most trusted brands of batteries have indicators showing the heath of battery. If not, ask service staff to confirm the health of battery and perform a battery test.
#  [[Image:New Tires.jpg|right|177px]]Confirm that all tires are new. Usually a new tire would have coloured stripes in centre which wear off once tire is used for some time.

#  Check the windshields for any cracks, scratches or spots that may be difficult to remove later. Check wiper operations. Check and operate all windows. Ensure Power windows (if applicable) work properly.
#  Check the interior of the car. Especially look out for any kind of soiling of seats, upholstery and carpets. Make sure every kind of cloth or leather to be intact.
#  [[Image:Kombi Instrument Test.jpg|right|184px]]Turn on the ignition.
#  Ensure that no warning lights are flashing on the instrument cluster.
#  Ensure that fuel level is adequate and engine temperature is within acceptable range.

#  Crank the engine. Lookout for any weird sound from engine compartment. It is advisable to crank the engine and then step out of the vehicle to inspect the sound of the vehicle. While you are at it, also check the emission levels from exhaust.
#  Turn on the air-conditioning / heating. Ensure it provides you with sufficient cooling / heating.
#  Try to operate and test all the bells and whistles that may have come with your car.
#  [[Image:Car headlights on a barrel.jpg|right|184px]]Switch on the headlights, fog lamps and parking lights. Confirm that they operate properly. Ensure that headlights focus properly.
#  Check the A/V system. Carry your favourite CD to test the sound system.
#  Buckle Up and request a short test drive before delivery. At this point, switch off the music system and put the air-conditioning on low speed so that you can listen to any abnormality.
#  Shift into gears. Ensure that they slot properly and vehicle had decent acceleration.
#  On your test drive, look for any abnormal sounds from engine or suspension system. Also, ensure that there are no rattles and NVH (Noise, Vibration and Harshness) levels are acceptable.
#  On a straight stretch, drive at a speed of 60 kmph and check that vehicle is properly aligned to road and there is no unusual vibration.
#  [[Image:Flickr note try out.jpg|right|180px]]Return to service centre. Park the vehicle. Step out and open the hood. Check for any fluid leaks that may have popped up during trial.
#  Meet the service manager and get all possible information regarding servie schedules and good driving etiquettes.
#  [[Image:Business Cards 2.jpg|right|179px]]Exchange business cards with salesperson, and service personnel.
#  Bring to notice any faults that you may have encountered during the inspection.
#  Note down Chassis No. and Engine No. of vehicle and confirm that it matches with the paperwork
#  Check Air Pressure on the vehicle.
#  You are now ready to go! But, before you leave, do take a snap with you purchase and all those people who made your dream car a reality :)
# [[Image:Huzzah!.jpg|right|184px]]Drive off and Show off !
#  Check all additional items to be present in the vehicle like spare tire, CD Changer, tool kits and warning triangles.
== Tips ==
*Call couple of days in advance and fix a delivery date and time so that there is minimum hurry.
*Bring along a friend or colleague. A third person with little emotional attachment to your new car will provide a non-biased opinion during inspection.
*Have all types of paperwork ready which may be required for delivery of vehicle.
*Carry a Still Camera / Camcorder to capture your moment of joy as well as serve as proof for any defect found.
*Be courteous to staff. After all, you may be returning there for all your service needs.
== Warnings ==
*Remember ! It may be a highly emotional moment for you but is routine for staff.
*Vehicle Delivery during late evenings and night is an absolute NO!
== Things You'll Need ==
*Required documentation
*Delivery Order of Financier if required
*Pen
*Still Camera / Camcorder
*Pre recorded Audio Cassette / CD / DVD / USB Stick
*Gift for salesperson (Optional)
